analyst_view.overall: Leaders PSG (23 points, five straight league wins and eleven in a row in all competitions) visit sixth-placed Nice (17 points), who have won five of their last six league games under Olivier Pantaloni. The news has changed since this morning: PSG's Friday medical report clears Dembélé, Marquinhos, Nuno Mendes, Doué and Akliouche, and Luis Enrique said only Kvaratskhelia and Longoni are missing, so the numbers (which only take Kvaratskhelia off) are now close to right on availability. Luis Enrique also said he will look at each player's minutes, and with Roma at the Parc on Wednesday, French reports expect the returning stars on the bench and a rotated XI with Mayulu, Ndjantou, Ferran Torres and Godts. Nice are without Abdelmonem (hamstring, not risked) plus long-term absentees Bombito, Abergel and Mendy, all already in the numbers; Boudaoui and Abdi may return. Referee Jérôme Brisard (4.2 cards a game) is already counted.

goals.text: The numbers say 3.1 goals, with PSG's strong scoring run and Kvaratskhelia's absence (-4%) already counted. Dembélé, Doué and Akliouche are now fit, so I cut my trim from -3 to -2, but they are expected to start on the bench with Roma on Wednesday, so the first hour likely belongs to a younger PSG front line; about 3.0 goals.

corners.text: The numbers say 9.5 corners, driven by PSG's possession against a Nice side that has been strong at home. Rotation changes who attacks more than how often PSG push Nice back, and Nice's form and missing defenders are already in the numbers, so I stay at 9.5.

cards.text: The numbers say 3.5 cards and already include Jérôme Brisard's slightly above-average record (+9.5%), Nice's recent rise in cards and PSG's low count. I found nothing new on discipline or the referee, so I stay at 3.5.

shots.text: The numbers say 29.7 shots, already raised for both sides' recent shooting. PSG will still have most of the ball, but a rotated starting XI after the international break, with stars managed before Roma, should be a little less sharp; a small cut to about 29.1.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 12.3 shots on target and already give PSG +20% for 60 on target in their last six. Dembélé and Doué, their most dangerous shooters, are fit again but likely to start on the bench, so I keep a small trim, now -2 instead of -3, to about 12.1.
